senses.gloss: m. (הֲדַר) coil, convolution. ה׳ דכנתא the coils of the ileum.
units: Is. XLV, 2) spiral road, a field whichcan be tilled only by spiral movements, steep hill.
B. Bath. 12ᵃ בה׳ in the case of a steep ascent (which requires more time).—בית ה׳ Beth-Hăduré, name of a summit from which the scape-goat was thrown down (Lev. XVI, 21 sq.).
